name: Situational Awareness LP
blurb: AGI-thesis fund from the author of 'Situational Awareness'. Concentrated bets on the AI buildout — compute, power, semis.
status_note: Prime brokers issued margin calls on a roughly 4x levered book and the fund sold the bulk of its public equity portfolio to Citadel, cutting assets from over $20B to about $10B. Its private positions were retained, including its Anthropic stake. The holdings below are the last 13F, filed for the quarter ended 2026-03-31, and are no longer held. Since then it has begun redeploying, and the company it was backing has been named: Source Foundry, a stealth chip startup founded by Stanford researchers that is trying to make semiconductor manufacturing cheaper and faster. It added $400M in the week of 2026-08-09, bringing its total in the company to $500M after an initial $100M. Both figures circulate in coverage because they measure different things — the latest tranche and the cumulative stake — so neither contradicts the other. A private position never appears in a 13F, so none of it changes the frozen mark below, which prices the public book that was sold rather than the firm.

blurb: The 'Big Short' investor. Tiny, contrarian, often hedged book with sharp, concentrated convictions.
status_note: Michael Burry deregistered Scion Asset Management with the SEC; its registration shows as terminated. In a letter to investors dated 27 October 2025 he said he would liquidate the funds and return capital by year-end, writing that his estimation of value in securities had not been in sync with the markets for some time. The holdings below are the last 13F Scion filed and are not a live book. He did not stop investing, though — since November 2025 he has published Cassandra Unchained on Substack, and since late July 2026 a near-daily 'Trading Post' describing his own buys, shorts and options. That is more current than a 13F ever was, and covers shorts and options a 13F never showed, but it is paid and not machine-readable: this app can see that he wrote and when, never what he holds.
